epicysm.command.no_models: No readable YSM models found. Plain model folders and zips are read from config/yes_steve_model (custom, builtin, auth) and config/epicysm/models.
epicysm.settings.title: EpicYSM settings
epicysm.settings.overlay: Epic Fight animations on encrypted models
epicysm.settings.overlay.tooltip: Encrypted .ysm models are drawn by Yes Steve Model, and this mod poses their skeleton with Epic Fight's animations. Off: encrypted models fight with their own animations.
epicysm.settings.items.tooltip: Who draws the weapon in the hand of an encrypted model in battle: Epic Fight (its own look, its own add-ons) or Yes Steve Model (the plain item).
epicysm.settings.bow.tooltip: Which animation plays while the use key is held on a bow or crossbow. Attacks with the attack key are always Epic Fight's.
epicysm.settings.armor.tooltip: Draw the armor the player wears over a converted YSM model. Off by default: the model is shown as its author made it, the way Yes Steve Model shows it.
epicysm.settings.hide_locked.tooltip: Many models are built holding a sword or wearing a sheath. In battle those are put away so only the item actually in hand is shown. Names that are not recognised can be added to config/epicysm/hidden-bones.txt.
epicysm.settings.hide_open.tooltip: The same for models this mod can read and convert.
epicysm.settings.hold.tooltip: How much of Yes Steve Model's own animation keeps playing while Epic Fight poses the body. Stop everywhere: like a converted model, hair and cloth follow the body rigidly. Stop on the body: hair and props keep their own motion. Play under: nothing is stopped.
epicysm.settings.unreadable.tooltip: When Epic Fight animations on encrypted models are off: keep the model with its own animations, or keep Epic Fight's animations on a plain body.
epicysm.settings.own_animations: Model's own animation in battle (readable models)
epicysm.settings.own_animations.tooltip: Bones Epic Fight has no joint for - tails, ears, wings, hair - keep playing the model's own standing, walking and swimming animation while Epic Fight moves the body. On by default; takes effect after /epicysm reload.
epicysm.settings.physics.tooltip: Secondary motion on converted models: hair, skirts, capes and ribbons swing with the body. Off by default.
epicysm.settings.diagnostics.tooltip: Detailed log lines and description files for every model (config/epicysm). Turn on when reporting a problem.
